welcome:
Welcome to the Apache Kafka CLI Playground.
Type commands to explore a simulated 3-broker production cluster.
Type 'help' for available commands, 'scenario' for guided labs.

steps.instruction: List all consumer groups to see what's running on the cluster.
The 'payments-processor' group looks suspicious. Describe it to check lag.
High lag on partitions 3 and 5. Check the topic details to understand partition layout.
Check which brokers are leaders for the lagging partitions. List broker log dirs for disk usage.
Broker 2 is overloaded. Check the topic's retention config to see if old data is piling up.
Retention is 7 days — too long for this high-throughput topic. Let's check the consumer group state.
Two members are stuck. Reset offsets to latest for the lagging partitions to skip the backlog.
Verify the lag is now cleared.

scenarios.title: Create and Test a New Topic

steps.instruction: List existing topics to see what's already on the cluster.
Create a new 'audit-events' topic with 8 partitions and replication factor 3.
Verify the topic was created correctly. Describe it.
Produce a few test messages to the new topic.
Consume the messages from the beginning to verify they arrived.
Set retention to 30 days and enable compact cleanup policy for audit compliance.
Run a quick performance test to baseline throughput on the new topic.
Verify the final topic configuration looks correct.

Available commands:
  kafka-topics.sh              — Create, list, describe, alter, delete topics
  kafka-console-producer.sh    — Produce messages to a topic
  kafka-console-consumer.sh    — Consume messages from a topic
  kafka-consumer-groups.sh     — List, describe, reset consumer groups
  kafka-configs.sh             — Describe and alter topic/broker configs
  kafka-log-dirs.sh            — Describe broker log directories
  kafka-broker-api-versions.sh — Show broker API versions
  kafka-metadata.sh            — Show KRaft metadata (cluster info)
  kafka-producer-perf-test.sh  — Producer performance benchmarking
  kafka-consumer-perf-test.sh  — Consumer performance benchmarking
  kafka-acls.sh                — Manage access control lists

  scenario                     — Start a guided lab
  clear                        — Clear the terminal
  help                         — Show this help
